request.title: Keep Party grids and disclosure actions bounded with enlarged text
request.description: The current 360-pixel enlarged-text Party fixture overflows to 592 pixels. The detail grid uses an 18-rem minimum; the member Details action also has a fixed seven-rem minimum wider than the available card content.
request.expected_behavior: Keep Party summary, member details and actions within the available width at normal and enlarged text without hiding content or reducing text size.
request.source: .skill-tree/artifacts/ux-ui/game-control-names/1793725405172118000/failure.json and failure.png; app.css party-detail-grid and party-member-actions rules.
request.priority_reason: The rendered changed-route check cannot pass while an existing grid and action exceed the phone viewport.
